DailyLeaderboardEntry.title: DailyLeaderboardEntry
DailyLeaderboardEntry.description: A player's best score entry for a specific date's procedural Daily Puzzle Challenge.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the player.

displayName.description: Public display name of the player for the leaderboard.

score.description: Best score achieved on this daily puzzle challenge.

linesCleared.description: Lines cleared in the best run.

maxCombo.description: Highest combo streak achieved in the best run.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest high-score update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

GlobalLeaderboardEntry.title: GlobalLeaderboardEntry
GlobalLeaderboardEntry.description: A player's cumulative all-time total score and career stats for the real-time global leaderboard.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the player.

displayName.description: Public display name of the player for the global leaderboard.

totalScore.description: Cumulative total score earned across all games of all time.

bestScore.description: Highest single-game score achieved across all time.

totalLinesCleared.description: Cumulative lines cleared across all time.

highestCombo.description: Highest combo multiplier streak achieved across all time.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial leaderboard entry creation (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest score update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SavedGameSession.title: SavedGameSession
SavedGameSession.description: Serialized in-progress game session allowing a player to resume across app exits and devices.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the session owner.

gameMode.description: Game mode for this saved session.

gridFlat.description: Row-major 64-element list of color IDs representing the 8x8 board.

pieces.description: 3-element list of slot maps representing active pieces in the tray.

maxComboSession.description: Highest combo achieved during this session.

linesClearedSession.description: Total lines cleared during this session.

isGameOver.description: Whether the game session has ended.

secondChanceAvailable.description: Whether the second-chance 3x3 blast is still unused.

dailyBatchIndex.description: Current procedural piece batch index for Daily Challenge.

clientUpdatedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds of last save for local/cloud conflict resolution.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial session creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last session update.

/daily_challenges/{dateStr}/scores/{user.description: Global leaderboard scores for a given day's procedurally generated 8x8 puzzle challenge.

/global_leaderboard/{userId}.description: All-time global leaderboard ranked by cumulative total score across all games.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Private user-scoped active game sessions (classic or daily) for seamless resume.
